{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove $ and commas, then convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '').str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify completed orders that are not test orders
# Assume 'converted' = 1 means non-test (real) orders
completed_non_test = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)]

# Calculate total revenue from these orders
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
